# F1 addendum — REVISIT-2 (2026-08-11)

Operator-visible addendum from the [adjudication history removed]/chainability pass.
Not a revision; append-only working note beside finding.json.

## 1. Hardening notes (from C1 LFI [adjudication history removed])

# LANE r4_d05 — F1 addendum (hardening notes) + verification

Target pinned commit verified: `cfb9f07c281effcb0683e8372fd0ee4edda498bf` (git rev-parse HEAD). Read-only analysis; no edits to the target repo.

## (1) Verdicts per question

| Item | Verdict | Mechanism / blocking control (file:line) |
|---|---|---|
| (a) validate-entity full-pipeline-execution smell | **CONFIRMED (static)** | `POST /validate-entity` accepts `{entity, location}` with a `url:`-only location ref (createRouter.ts:917-920) but then runs the **entire** processing pipeline via `AuthorizedValidationService.process` (createRouter.ts:936 → AuthorizedValidationService.ts:44-57 → DefaultCatalogProcessingOrchestrator.processSingleEntity). The pipeline unconditionally includes `if (isLocationEntity(entity)) { await this.runSpecialLocationStep(...) }` (DefaultCatalogProcessingOrchestrator.ts:161-162) between validate (160) and postProcess (164). A submitted entity of `kind: Location` with `spec.type: file` therefore triggers server-side file reads from an endpoint whose contract is entity validation, and errors are echoed verbatim (`serializeError`, createRouter.ts:954, 959-961). The only gate is `catalogEntityValidatePermission` (permissions.ts:98-103, empty attributes, no resource rules) → allowed under default/permission-disabled configs. |
| (b) FileReaderProcessor unguarded | **CONFIRMED (static)** | FileReaderProcessor.ts:31-82 — `readLocation` globs `location.target` (47-49) and `fs.readFile`s matches (53). No allowlist, no root containment, no `..` traversal check, no symlink-resolution check, no glob-metacharacter restriction. |
| (c) error-differential probe + yaml snippet leak | **CONFIRMED (static)** | Three-way differential per target: `file <target> does not exist` (FileReaderProcessor.ts:74-76) vs `file <target> could not be read, <e>` (78-80) vs success/parse-error; plus inputError for separator-suffixed targets (DefaultCatalogProcessingOrchestrator.ts:355-360). Parser errors embed yaml@2 `YAMLParseError`, whose message includes the offending **source line**: `YAML error at ${loc}, ${document.errors[0]}` (catalog-node parse.ts:74; also 66). In-repo test asserts the message contains the actual content line (`apiVersion: backstage.io/v1alpha1`) — parse.test.ts:203-212. Batchable via `spec.targets` array (DefaultCatalogProcessingOrchestrator.ts:354-358) and multiple Location entities per document. |
| (d) spec.type bypass of allowedLocationTypes (root cause) | **CONFIRMED (static)** | The allowlist check is enforced only on the top-level service input: `createLocation` checks `input.type` at DefaultLocationService.ts:68 (default `['url']`, line 51; `updateLocation` line 111-116). `runSpecialLocationStep` consumes `entity.spec.type` **verbatim** (`const { type = context.location.type ... } = entity.spec`, DefaultCatalogProcessingOrchestrator.ts:349-352) with no re-check. FileReaderProcessor is in the default processor set (CatalogBuilder.ts:329-334, pushed at 660). `toAbsoluteUrl` returns the target untouched when origin type ≠ target type (util.ts:58-78), so an absolute `file:` target from a `url:` origin passes through. `dryRunCreateLocation` (DefaultLocationService.ts:168-213) recursively runs the pipeline (processEntities 131-165) and returns read entities in the HTTP body (createRouter.ts:652-655). |
| (e) LFI×NEW-1 workspace-window chain | **CONFIRMED (static)** | Scaffolder task workspace = `path.join(this.options.workingDirectory, taskId)` (NunjucksWorkflowRunner.ts:640); workingDirectory from `backend.workingDirectory` (helpers.ts:40-58). Rendered template output incl. NEW-1 secret material lives there during execution; serialization gated on `scaffolder.EXPERIMENTAL_workspaceSerialization` (WorkspaceService.ts:60-90), workspace cleaned only on success (round-3 ledger, C7). The LFI's absolute `file:` read window covers `<workingDirectory>/<taskId>/...` in same-process deployments → read channel for on-disk rendered secrets. |
| (f) AMP-2 | **EXCLUDED per instruction** | [adjudication history removed] (config misread: events-backend + topic config gating); not included in the addendum. |

```markdown
# Internal advisory — F-F1 revision 2 (addendum: hardening notes)

Claim state: supported (unchanged). Adds residual-risk and hardening notes only;
does not alter claims claim-mechanism / claim-reach / claim-impact.

## Hardening notes (residual, from C1 file-type-Location analysis)

### H1. HEADLINE: authenticated catalog user can read arbitrary server-local files
Framing per policy-gate §[score removed]: the finding to harden against is the FILE READ
(server-local file disclosure via the catalog ingestion path), not "error text".
Error-message content is only the probe channel that makes the read usable
across non-entity files. Do not headline the error.

### H2. Root cause — allowlist enforced at the wrong layer
`allowedLocationTypes` gates only the top-level registration input
(DefaultLocationService.ts:68, default ['url'] at :51; updateLocation :111-116).
The nested Location entity's `spec.type` is consumed verbatim by
`runSpecialLocationStep` (DefaultCatalogProcessingOrchestrator.ts:349-352) with
NO check against the allowlist, and FileReaderProcessor is registered in the
default processor set (CatalogBuilder.ts:329-334, :660). A top-level `url:`
registration whose document embeds `kind: Location, spec: {type: file,
target: <abs path>}` therefore reaches `fs.readFile` (FileReaderProcessor.ts:53)
with the target returned unmodified by toAbsoluteUrl (util.ts:58-78).
dryRunCreateLocation returns the read entities directly in the HTTP response
(DefaultLocationService.ts:168-213; createRouter.ts:652-655).

### H3. validate-entity runs the full pipeline (smell)
POST /validate-entity (createRouter.ts:898-961) is contractually an entity
validator (url-only location ref, :917-920) yet executes the complete processing
pipeline, including the Location special step (DefaultCatalogProcessingOrchestrator.ts:161-162,
:341-423), and echoes serialized errors to the caller (:954, :959-961). It is
therefore a second no-persist read+oracle trigger in addition to dry-run
POST /locations. Gate: catalogEntityValidatePermission (empty attributes;
permissions.ts:98-103) — allowed under default/permission-disabled configs.

### H4. FileReaderProcessor guard recommendation
FileReaderProcessor.ts:31-82 has no allowlist, no root containment, no `..`
traversal check, no symlink-resolution check, no glob-metacharacter restriction.
Recommend (any one materially reduces exposure; first two are the real fix):
1. Resolve + contain before read: `path.resolve` then realpath both the root and
   the target, and require the realpath to stay under a configured catalog root
   (defeats symlink escape).
2. Re-apply `allowedLocationTypes` inside runSpecialLocationStep to
   `entity.spec.type` (the missing control that makes H2 possible).
3. Reject or restrict glob metacharacters in `file:` targets, or restrict the
   `file:` type itself to a deployment-controlled admin capability.

### H5. Error-differential probe capability + yaml snippet leak
Per-target three-way differential: `does not exist` (FileReaderProcessor.ts:74-76)
vs `could not be read, <e>` (:78-80) vs success/parse-error, plus inputError for
separator-suffixed targets (DefaultCatalogProcessingOrchestrator.ts:355-360),
batchable via spec.targets (:354-358). Parser errors embed yaml@2 YAMLParseError
messages that include the offending source LINE (catalog-node parse.ts:66, :74),
confirmed by in-repo test parse.test.ts:203-212 (message contains the actual
`apiVersion:` content line). Consequence: for any readable file that is not valid
entity YAML, the response carries a content snippet → the read is an oracle
beyond the entity-shaped-YAML window. Fixing H4 removes this channel.

### H6. Chain: LFI × NEW-1 workspace window
Scaffolder task workspace = workingDirectory/<taskId> (NunjucksWorkflowRunner.ts:640;
workingDirectory from backend.workingDirectory, helpers.ts:40-58). Rendered
template output — including NEW-1 secret material — is on disk during execution
(serialization gated: WorkspaceService.ts:60-90; workspace-at-rest retained on
failure). The file-type LFI read window covers that directory in same-process
deployments: C1 provides a read channel for NEW-1's on-disk secrets without the
task-event-log side channel. Cross-finding hardening = H4 (block the read) AND
NEW-1 remediation (never write secrets to the workspace).

### H7. Severity note
The mechanism is real (orchestrator-level, end-to-end confirmed). Standalone
filing was declined this pass (documented-accepted class + descriptive-error
exclusion + ~zero marginal content; [band removed]/[band removed] expectations). If the
operator later wants a standalone [band removed]/[band removed], the severity/CVSS package
requirements from lane r3_d15 apply.

## Uncertainty (unchanged)
- deployment prevalence / config-gating may vary
```

```markdown
# Internal advisory — F-F1 revision 2 (addendum: evidence + hardening)
Claim state: supported (unchanged). Adds robustness evidence and residual-risk/
hardening notes; does not alter claim-mechanism / claim-reach / claim-impact.

## Part A — Evidence addendum (r4_d09, folding r3_d07)

### A1. {nocase:true, dot:true} minimatch contract
matchLocation minimatches the RAW, still-encoded location.target
(CatalogRules.ts:208-214); nothing decodes/normalizes first (:193-221).
Consequences (minimatch v10 contract; pinned ^10.2.1, package.json:94):
- nocase:true — case variants of literal segments match (`Trusted-Org`,
  uppercase hex `%2E%2E`); the rule skeleton is case-insensitive.
- dot:true — `*`/`?`/`**` match `.`-prefixed segments, so dot-leading
  intermediates (`.attacker`) sit inside the matched region. Payload-space
  widening, not a new mechanism.

### A2. Globstar-chain payload class (P6) — exact payloads
Under a broad rule `pattern: https://github.test/trusted-org/**`:
- arbitrary-depth encoded-dot chain:
  `https://github.test/trusted-org/%2e%2e/%2e%2e/%2e%2e/attacker/repo/blob/main/catalog-info.yaml`
  (each `%2e%2e` is one ordinary text segment to minimatch; `**` admits any
  depth; git-url-parse decodes pathname, node-fetch `new URL().toString()`
  collapses the `..` → fetch targets attacker's repo).
- dot-prefixed intermediate (dot:true):
  `https://github.test/trusted-org/%2e%2e/.attacker/repo/blob/main/catalog-info.yaml`
- case variant (nocase): `%2E%2E` anywhere above.
Under a NARROW `*` rule `pattern: https://github.test/trusted-org/*/blob/master/*.yaml`
(proven at runtime, poc log PASS): target
`https://github.test/trusted-org/%2e%2e%2fprivate-co%2fsecret-repo/blob/master/catalog-info.yaml`
— `%2f` keeps one minimatch segment; decoded owner=`trusted-org/../private-co`,
name=`secret-repo`; the real GitHub reader requested `/repos/private-co/
secret-repo/contents/catalog-info.yaml` (collapsed), not the trusted path.
Source spine: parseGitUrlSafe checks filepath only (`packages/integration/src/
helpers.ts:28-51`, guard :42-48) → owner/name raw into fetch URL
(`packages/integration/src/github/core.ts:57-60`).

### A3. Exact-rule cap proof (bounds INGESTION only)
Why byte-exact patterns resist: the raw target string equals the pattern
byte-for-byte at match time (CatalogRules.ts:205 strict `!==`; no parse, no
decode → zero parser-disagreement surface). Per-location rules are exact by
construction (CatalogRules.ts:147-163; resolveTarget :255-259 passes non-file
targets through untouched). Why the cap is ingestion-only: the reader's
decoded interpretation is never re-checked — runSpecialLocationStep fetches
(:161-163) BEFORE isAllowed (:166-186), so under an exact rule the fetch still
happens with the integration credential and the result is merely discarded.
Runtime proof (existing poc log): "exact rule ... REJECTS the identical
encoded-slash payload — the real orchestrator throws via
CatalogRulesEnforcer.isAllowed ... even though the reader still fetched the
collapsed path." Residual F-A1 stands: credentialed blind read on any
POST /locations, independent of rule outcome.

### A4. Rule-shape × reader coverage table
Payload classes: A isolated `%2e%2e` (defeats `**`); B encoded-slash
`%2e%2e%2f` (one minimatch segment, defeats `*`); C case/dot variants (widens
A/B); D arbitrary-depth `%2e%2e` chains (broad only). None = resisted.

| Reader (parse site) | exact (global + per-location) | narrow `*` | broad `**` |
|---|---|---|---|
| GitHub (github/core.ts:57-60) | none (byte-eq; F-A1 blind fetch) | B, C | A, C, D |
| Bitbucket Cloud (bitbucketCloud/core.ts:169,197) | none | B, C | A, C, D |
| Bitbucket Server (bitbucketServer/core.ts:83,117) | none | B (raw `%2f` + node-fetch collapse) | A, C, D |
| GitLab (gitlab/core.ts:84,121; encodeURIComponent round-trip :93-100) | none | none (mitigated) | A, C, D |
| Azure DevOps (AzureUrl.fromRepoUrl) | none | none (mitigated) | A, C, D |
| Harness (harness/core.ts:196) | none | unresolved (server-dependent) | A, C, D |
| Gerrit/Gitiles (gerrit/core.ts:51) | none | untested | A, C, D |
| Gitea (gitea/core.ts:156, naive split) | none | immune (structural) | immune (structural) |
| Generic fetch (`backend.reading.allow`) | none | n/a | host-allow: A,C,D; paths-restricted: none |

Per-host `catalog.locations[].rules` = exact by construction → resists all
classes at ingestion (A3). Record fix (carried from r3_d07): claim-reach says
"6 of 8 SCM readers" but enumerates 7 affected + Gitea immune → correct to
"7 of 8" or re-justify; minimatch citation = 10.2.1 (locked), not 10.2.5.

## Part B — Hardening notes (r4_d05, folded)

### H1. HEADLINE — the read, not the error text
Policy-gate §[score removed]: harden against the FILE READ (server-local file disclosure
via catalog ingestion); error content is only the probe channel that makes the
read usable across non-entity files.

### H2. Root cause — allowlist at the wrong layer
allowedLocationTypes gates only top-level input (DefaultLocationService.ts:68,
default ['url'] :51; updateLocation :111-116). Nested Location entity
`spec.type` is consumed verbatim by runSpecialLocationStep
(DefaultCatalogProcessingOrchestrator.ts:349-352) with no re-check, and

target: <abs path>}` reaches fs.readFile (FileReaderProcessor.ts:53) with the
target unmodified by toAbsoluteUrl (util.ts:58-78); dryRunCreateLocation
returns read entities in the HTTP body (DefaultLocationService.ts:168-213;

### H3. validate-entity full-pipeline smell
POST /validate-entity (createRouter.ts:898-961) is contractually a validator
(url-only location ref, :917-920) yet runs the whole pipeline incl. the
Location special step (orchestrator :161-162, :341-423) and echoes serialized

### H4. FileReaderProcessor guard (recommend)

### H5. Error-differential probe + yaml snippet leak
Three-way per-target differential: `does not exist` (FileReaderProcessor.ts:
74-76) vs `could not be read, <e>` (:78-80) vs success/parse-error; inputError
for separator-suffixed targets (orchestrator :355-360); batchable via

### H6. Chain: LFI × NEW-1 workspace window
Scaffolder workspace = workingDirectory/<taskId> (NunjucksWorkflowRunner.ts:

### H7. Severity note
Mechanism real (orchestrator-level confirmed). Standalone filing declined this
pass (documented-accepted class + descriptive-error exclusion + ~zero marginal
content; [band removed]/[band removed]). A future standalone [band removed]/[band removed] must follow the
severity/CVSS package requirements from lane r3_d15.

## Uncertainty (unchanged)
- deployment prevalence / config-gating may vary; exact cap leaves F-A1 blind
  read; globstar-chain extent beyond minimatch contract untested.
```

## Verification basis
